We love spreading cheer to small businesses across the country, so we figured there’s no better time than the holidays to let some of our clients shine. We'll be counting down the days to Christmas with our 12 Days of Small Businesses, and we start today by focusing on our lawyers. Just like finding a good lawyer, finding a trustworthy digital marketing company can be overwhelming. That’s why these attorneys turned to us to manage their web presence. As preferred vendors of the ABA, NACDL and AAPDA, we offer member discounts and peace of mind to those in the legal industry.

The Richardson Law Firm | Client Since December 2015 | https://therichardsonlawfirm.com/

Tony Richardson is an expert in LGBT family law in Kissimmee, FL. Last year, the Richardson Law Firm entered the Kissimmee Parade festivities with a vehicle with the theme of “Adopt a Pet, Save a Life.” They brought along their own adopted furry friends as ambassadors.

Law Offices of Deborah Wysni, LLC. | Client Since December 2014 | https://wysnilaw.com/

Deborah Wysni is a member of the American Bar Association, the Pennsylvania Bar Association and the Allegheny County Bar Association. She is also a member of the Women in the Profession Commission of the Pennsylvania Bar Association. She received a CALI Award for Arbitration, a Pro-Bono Award and a Certificate of Distinction from the Community Enterprise Clinic at Duquesne University for her work with nonprofit entities.

Law Office of Brian Palmer, LLC | Client Since December 2016 | https://brianpalmerlaw.com/

Brian Palmer handles personal injury, medical malpractice, premises liability, nursing home negligence and wrongful death claims and has done so for over 25 years. He loves the practice of law and would not do anything else.

Quirk Law, LLC | Client Since December 2014 | https://quirklawllc.com/

William J. Quirk is an attorney practicing in the areas of immigration law, criminal law, municipal court and non-profit law. He is a member of the American Bar Association, the American Immigration Lawyers Association and the Bergen County Bar Association. Bill is incredibly passionate about helping his clients, and he also teaches occasionally. He and his wife have a beautiful daughter.

Law Offices of Talley A. Lattimore, LLC | Client Since December 2014 | https://lattimorelawoffices.com/

Talley A. Lattimore, Attorney at Law attended college right up the road from us at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and graduated from the University of South Carolina School of Law soon after. The Law Offices of Talley A. Lattimore, LLC centers around residential real estate in Columbia, SC, where Talley enjoys running and cycling in his down time.

Breen Law Office & Mediation | Client Since December 2015 | https://breenlaw.org

Jennifer Breen, Attorney at Law was raised in North Adams, MA and decided to come home to the Berkshires to practice law after working as an assistant district attorney in Middlesex County. Jennifer has several certifications in a specific type of family law and mediation that only a handful of people in the entire state of MA have.

The Coyle Law Group | Client Since December 2015 | https://thecoylelawgroup.com/

Attorney Michael Coyle is the founding partner of The Coyle Law Group. Prior to the Coyle Law Group, Michael was a law clerk to The Honorable Robert J. Yock. Mr. Coyle then worked as an attorney with several of the largest law firms in the country before starting his own practice. The Coyle Law Group just opened their second office in Columbia, MD.

Barrows Legal Group, LLC | Client Since December 2015 | https://barrowslegal.com/

Chris Barrows has been a registered family law mediator in Indiana since 2005. He was admitted to practice in 1999 and has been certified by the Family Law Certification Board as a Family Law Specialist. This year, Chris was voted one of the top arbitrators and mediators in Indianapolis, IN.

Hayden & Butler, P.S.C. | Client Since December 2014 | https://bankruptcycheeper.com/

Jennifer Pitcock is one of the newest members of Hayden & Butler, P.S.C., a firm of bankruptcy attorneys in Lexington, KY. Jennifer loves Halloween! Last year she dressed her son up as Scooby-Doo, she was Velma, and her husband was Shaggy.

Notary Public Plus | Client Since December 2015 | https://notarypublicplus.com/

Minos Nunez, the proprietor of Notary Public Plus in Lafayette, LA, is a non-attorney notary specializing in wills and small successions. Minos is a member of the Louisiana Notary Association and loves to go fishing with his kids in his free time.

Stay tuned for more highlights across our client's industry, tomorrow we'll be highlighting Eleven Red-Nosed Restaurants.
